label: P3, P4 & P5 - Arms
notes: The Upgrades tab bundles this set for a warrior whose Arms tree has strictly more talent points than each other tree (ticket 803); fallback.ep-weights.json (P1 Fury) serves every other warrior.

Why P3 and not P1_ARMS_EP_PRESET ('P1, P2 - Arms'): upstream's own Arms builds for phases 3, 4 and 5 use this set (P3_PRESET_BUILD_ARMS, P4_PRESET_BUILD_ARMS and P5_PRESET_BUILD_ARMS in ui/specs/warrior/dps/presets.ts:446-480), and the page opens at phase 3 (CURRENT_PHASE in ui/sim/constants/other.ts:12; currentPhase in data/wowsims.lock.json), so phase 3 is what the tab ranks by default. P1_ARMS_EP_PRESET is not transcribed. The tab's assumptions line says when a run ranks a phase other than 3.
data/presets/ep-weights-by-phase.json and this repo's CLI do not read this file.
